notes.title: [Patch Notes] Alpha 2.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear friends, with each passing day we are getting closer and closer to having a stable server :D
Our goal is to have everything ready for the beta tests that will start soon, so please be patient.
I’m here to provide a summary of what’s included in this update below:

1 - Septaria Bonus System

 "Achievement Treasure" system has been added.
[olist]
The Achievement Treasure can be equipped in \[Achievement Treasures > Rest of the Sea Dragon], a system that allows you to produce special items every day.

Up to three Achievement Treasures can be equipped, and the quantity of items produced varies depending on the level of the equipped Achievement Treasure.
[/olist]
Rewards obtainable through Achievement Treasures are renewed every day at 4 AM and can be collected later at \[Achievement Treasures > Rest of the Sea Dragon].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/20ae2018cac002144ad2829d57b765ca8331d370.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/e34a76cfd5678f1c8879b0d5a975d2680ec7dc76.png"]
[olist]
Promotion offers a certain chance to increase the level of your Achievement Treasure by one level.
[/olist]
A total of 4 Achievement Treasures are used in promotion, and the success probability for promotion is the same at all levels, 10%.

Upon a successful upgrade, you can obtain 1 Achievement Treasure of a higher level.

If the promotion fails, all other Achievement Treasures, except the first registered Achievement Treasure, will disappear.
[olist]
The Achievement Treasure ‘Advanced/Rare/Heroic/Legendary Blue Breath Crystal’ has been added.
[/olist]
When equipped with the 'Blue Breath Crystal', you can receive the 'Blue Treasure Stone' every day at the Sea Dragon’s resting place.

Mythic Items
[olist]
The ancient sacred item 'Ragnos’ Necklace' has been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/703b67f8ca8bc1e30d772a32602fdbc8e13d3f72.png"]
[/olist][olist]
The default options for Ragnos’ Necklace consist of health, reduced PvP damage received, and increased heavy attack damage.

Upon reaching the Rare/Heroic/Legendary ranks, you can unlock additional stats.

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Alpha Update 1.9.1
notes.notes:
Hello, Nexus M4 Adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce the latest Nexus M4 update, introducing brand-new content and improvements that will take your gaming experience to the next level! Check out the highlights:

\[Main Updates]
[olist]
New Challenge: Tower of Fate
The Tower of Fate is the latest challenge content, where you can test your skills by facing increasingly powerful monsters across various difficulty levels.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/8dc0be729d1c50dd00499f1ce8328e73bebda300.png"]
[/olist]
How to access: Available for characters level 120 and above.

Game mode: Form groups of up to 5 players to conquer the gates.

Rewards: Use the "Tower of Fate Entry Ticket" to participate and earn exclusive rewards upon completing each stage for the first time!
[olist]
New Mythic Spirit: Kyssara
Kyssara is a spirit that debilitates enemies with powerful negative effects and boosts allies to deal more lethal damage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320373/e65c53ef5b63156fba1434be3f1c0644c8d66fca.png"]
[/olist]
How to obtain: Visit the NPC Wind Oracle in the Legendary Spirits Village and complete the Origin quest.
[olist]
New Ancestral Equipment: Han Sul’s Shoulderguards
The mighty Han Sul’s Shoulderguards have arrived in Nexus M4!
[/olist]
How to acquire: Craft them with forge NPCs, purchase them in the store, or earn them through missions and heroic achievements.
[olist]
New Appearances: Ancestral Weapons
Ancestral-themed weapon skins, inspired by the mystical power of spirits, are now available for all classes!
[/olist]
How to obtain: Purchase exchange coupons in the store to unlock these exclusive appearances.

More News Coming Soon!
Stay tuned, as we’ll soon bring even more updates to make your Nexus M4 journey even more epic! Get ready to explore, conquer, and dominate!


Nexus M4 Team
